Title: One with the Land for Christmas (Paris, France) - December 16th 2023

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I'm organizing a tournament in Paris on December 16th 2023. If you're visiting us by that time, feel free to register and play the tournament with us.

www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/11111

I'd like to draw your attention to the registration time (10.30am-10.50am) and the length of the lunch break (25 minutes). But there's a market right outside and plenty of street food available.

There will be lots of prizes, as usual, and not just cards!

Venue: Troll2Jeux 15-17 Place d'Aligre, 75012 Paris
Date: Saturday 16 December 2023
Times :
Registration: 10.30am - 10.50am
Round 1: 11am - 1pm
lunch break: 25 minutes
Round 2: 13:30 - 15:30
Round 3: 3.40pm - 5.40pm
Final: 5.50pm - 7:50pm

25 players max

This is a VEKN Paris tournament. Registration is €10 for association members and €13 for non-members. Membership of the association for the rest of 2023 is still possible, for 3€ (free Kuyen for new members).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
